# storykit

## Your pipeline fails silently 3 times a week; storykit tells you why in 10 seconds

One command reads the run log and names the failing step.

### Engineers spend 40 minutes per failure reading logs by hand

We measured 212 failures across six teams.

### storykit cuts that to 10 seconds with one command

It ranks the three most likely causes and links the line.

## Install it and run your first diagnosis today

Get started: `pip install storykit && storykit why`.
